requestProcess.authority: Montana Department of Environmental Quality via Montana Office of Public Information Requests
requestProcess.agencyTargetResponse: DEQ aims to fulfill requests within 30 days, not a guaranteed statutory response date

requestRounds.facility: United States Antimony Corporation – Thompson Falls Facility, Sanders County, Montana
requestRounds.subject: Records request — MAQP #2973-05 initial source-testing records (May–October 2026)
requestRounds.body: I request electronic copies of records currently held by the Montana Department of Environmental Quality concerning the United States Antimony Corporation Thompson Falls Facility, Montana Air Quality Permit #2973-05, dated May 1 through October 16, 2026, limited to initial compliance source testing under Section II.B.1 for the nine new reduction, remelt, and oxidizer furnaces: source-test protocol submissions, schedules or notifications specifying actual initial-startup or testing dates; any received completed test reports and associated compliance determinations; and any DEQ correspondence acknowledging receipt or review of those particular protocols or results. Please search by the proposed new furnace/emissions-unit identifiers RF-1500, RF-1600, RF-1700, RF-1800, RF-1900, RFF-2000, RFF-2100, OFF-2200, and OFF-2300, together with their corresponding baghouses BH-1500 through BH-2300; please include the exact furnace or emissions-unit ID in each responsive record where present. If no responsive records are held, please indicate that rather than inferring that a test did or did not occur. If these records are maintained under predecessor MAQP #2973-04, please search that permit file too. I have already obtained public release 26-PIR-1405 containing the 2025 permit application and determination records; please avoid re-sending those six 2025 documents. I seek records generated or received in May–October 2026 rather than copies of the application. I prefer electronic records, existing documents rather than new analysis, and a notice of estimated fees before chargeable work. Please provide reasonably segregable nonexempt portions if any material is withheld.
requestRounds.rationale: Permit Section II.B.1 specifies initial emissions testing after startup of all newly permitted units; only received regulator records could supply a reliable clock or observed results.

requestRounds.facility: United States Antimony Corporation – Thompson Falls Facility, Sanders County, Montana
requestRounds.subject: Follow-up records request — MAQP #2973-05 DEQ furnace inspections (May–October 2026)
requestRounds.body: I request electronic copies of any Montana DEQ Air Quality Bureau facility inspection reports or contemporaneous regulator field-visit notes currently held for United States Antimony Corporation's Thompson Falls Facility, MAQP #2973-05, dated May 1 through October 16, 2026, to the extent they document operation, startup, installed equipment, furnace identifiers, or inspection of the nine new reduction/remelt/oxidizer furnace units (the proposed new furnace/emissions-unit identifiers RF-1500, RF-1600, RF-1700, RF-1800, RF-1900, RFF-2000, RFF-2100, OFF-2200, and OFF-2300, together with their corresponding baghouses BH-1500 through BH-2300). Where an inspection report contains an equipment inventory or permitted emissions-unit list, please include that page or attachment; I am trying to distinguish the six older units listed in the December 2025 permit from a later press account referring to seven furnaces in the old building. Please also include DEQ-issued or DEQ-received changes/amendments to #2973-05 during this period that expressly modify the furnace list, if any; do not perform a new compliance assessment. If no responsive inspection or amendment records are held, please state that. I already have public release 26-PIR-1405 containing the 2025 application, BACT addendum and permitting determinations, so please avoid duplicating those six older documents. I prefer electronic copies of 2026 records, estimated fees before chargeable work, and reasonably segregable nonexempt portions if needed.
requestRounds.rationale: An actual regulator site observation and equipment ID reconciliation would be distinct from company forecast or journalistic site descriptions.

nextUseOfRecords.whenObtained: Save supplied original documents and metadata only in gitignored private evidence vault; derive stable hashes and preserve agency-provided dates after real access; separately assess authenticity and public-use rights.
nextUseOfRecords.reviewer: Route verified new source observations as candidates to the existing M3 original-source human adjudication; do not replace review ID, original SEC source or signed decision identity.
nextUseOfRecords.cutoff: Any new human decision after 2026-10-09 requires independently authorized corpus-date update and a fresh canonical review-input digest before publication.
nextUseOfRecords.publication: No automatic project-milestone seed, finance history, source registry, public route, export, or monitor update.
